Phases: intro (speaks first), reply (answers), taunt, hurt, lowhp, special, winRound, loseRound, winMatch, assist (speaker appears as a summoned helper for listener). Ids are generated as speaker.listener.phase.index and map to public/voice/<id>.mp3 for TTS.
